articles.summary:
Ukrainian president earlier rejected US call for Kyiv to stop bombing oil refineries, saying Moscow must first end attacks on energy infrastructure

Donald Trump has announced an energy ceasefire between Ukraine and Russia, apparently without consulting Volodymyr Zelenskyy, who said the deal to stop long-range attacks was “news to me”.

In a social media post, the US president claimed the two sides had reached an agreement. “Effective immediately, there is an ENERGY CEASEFIRE in the War between Russia and Ukraine. Both parties have agreed. Do not break it!” he wrote on Truth Social.

articles.title: Trump’s deal with Putin will have little impact on US diesel prices, experts say
articles.summary:
Analysts say fuel will take weeks to ship and quantity is too small to affect prices, while full deal is unlikely to be met given damage to Russian refineries

  • Trump announces partial ceasefire but Zelenskyy says deal is ‘news to me’

Donald Trump’s deal with Vladimir Putin to temporarily lift sanctions on US imports of Russian diesel will have little “meaningful” effect on motorists and businesses in the US and overseas, energy and foreign policy analysts have predicted.

The US president infuriated Volodymyr Zelenskyy when he announced the deal on Friday, writing on Truth Social that the agreement with his Russia counterpart to supply millions of tonnes of diesel was essential to reduce fuel prices in the US, which have soared after his decision to go to war against Iran.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí stupňujícímu se bezpečnostnímu tlaku v důsledku intenzivních ruských útoků na Ukrajině a nárůstu hybridních a sabotážních operací na kontinentu. Makroekonomické prostředí nadále komplikují fiskální spory v EU ohledně rozpočtových škrtů a přísnější bezpečnostní opatření včetně plánovaných vízových omezení pro ruské občany.
archive.security_status_en: Europe faces escalating security pressure due to intense Russian attacks in Ukraine and a surge in hybrid and sabotage operations across the continent. The macroeconomic environment continues to be complicated by EU fiscal disputes over budget cuts and stricter security measures including planned visa restrictions for Russian citizens.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, heightened market volatility is expected due to geopolitical tensions, security incidents, and ongoing political debates within the EU.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí stupňujícím se bezpečnostním rizikům včetně pokusu o atentát na polského premiéra Tuska a intenzivních ruských útoků na Ukrajině. Na politické scéně probíhají ostré spory ohledně návrhů EU rozpočtu, zatímco hospodářské trhy vstřebávají dopady amerických sankcí a nové dohody EU ohledně čínských elektromobilů.
archive.security_status_en: Europe faces escalating security risks including an attempted assassination plot against Polish Prime Minister Tusk and intense Russian strikes in Ukraine. The political scene sees sharp disputes over EU budget proposals, while economic markets absorb the impacts of US sanctions and a new EU agreement on Chinese electric vehicles.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, market fluctuations are expected under the influence of geopolitical news from Ukraine and ongoing European bank earnings reports.
